name: Blind Mary
summary: In a ruined farmhouse southeast of Darkshire, Blind Mary wanders as a tormented banshee. She was once a vain and beautiful mortal woman, but her violent death and transformation drove her to mutilate herself in grief over what she had become.

sections.title: A Tragic Vanity
sections.body: Mary was known for her beauty before the shadows fell across Duskwood. She took great pride in it and rarely went without her treasured looking glass. When the undead swept through the region, Mary and many of her neighbors were slain. Her spirit did not find rest in the earth. Instead, she became an ethereal banshee, condemned to wander the mortal realm in a ghastly, translucent form.

sections.title: Blinded by Despair
sections.body: When Mary awoke as one of the undead, sorrow, horror, and fury overwhelmed her. She could not bear the sight of her monstrous reflection, so she clawed out her own eyes with her bare hands. She cast away her beloved looking glass and drifted through her abandoned home, blind and weeping, clinging to faint memories of the mortal life she lost.

faq.answer: Blind Mary is a banshee haunting a ruined homestead southeast of Darkshire. She was a beautiful local woman, slain when Duskwood fell into darkness, then raised as an undead spirit.

faq.q: Why is she called Blind Mary?
aliases: how did blind mary lose her eyes
faq.answer: Mary clawed out her own eyes because grief and despair over her banshee form made her unable to bear her reflection.
Blind Mary lingers inside a dilapidated farmhouse called Blind Mary's Haunt, southeast of Darkshire in eastern Duskwood.

faq.q: Is Blind Mary hostile to living travelers?
aliases: can you talk to blind mary
faq.answer: Blind Mary does not attack travelers on sight. Unlike the aggressive ghouls and skeletons in the surrounding woods, she remains trapped in mourning and can be spoken to by those who approach her ruined home.

faq.q: What happened to Mary's looking glass?
faq.answer: Mary cast away her prized looking glass after tearing out her eyes in horror at her spectral form. It remains lost somewhere in Duskwood's haunted reaches.

faq.q: Why do adventurers seek out Blind Mary?
faq.answer: Travelers and local artisans visit Mary while carrying out work around Darkshire. Some seek her old looking glass for Viktori Prism'Antras's star-gazing device; others bring Madame Eva's spectral comb to gather ghost hair for special thread.

angles.text: As a tailor, you may seek spectral entities like Mary for ghost hair thread, a delicate material woven from ethereal remnants.
As a priest, you can see in Mary a soul left untethered by horrific trauma, caught between life and damnation through grief and vanity.
As an Alliance defender, you can see Mary's fate as a reminder of how deeply Duskwood's curse has devastated its everyday townsfolk.
